skill.name: goal-setter
skill.description: Transforms objectives into structured goals with measurable success criteria, milestones, subgoals, autonomy settings, and LeanOS canvas links.
skill.summary: Turn intent into measurable LeanOS goals with plans and milestones.
skill.author: BellaBe

security_audit.summary: I reviewed SKILL.md and found the static alerts are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline file names, and planning terms. The scanned file contains prose instructions only, with no executable script, shell invocation, network call, prompt injection, or data exfiltration intent.

static_findings.snippet: - Existing goals (`strategy/goals/active/*`) - avoid conflicts, find linkages
| `01.context.md` | Product, market context (KBOS) | Goal alignment check |
| `04.segments.md` | Customer segments | Target audience for goals |
| `10.assumptions.md` | Hypotheses, validation status | **Key** - link goals to assumptions |
| `12.revenue.md` | Revenue model, tiers | Revenue goal targets |
| `13.metrics.md` | Key metrics, targets | Success criteria source |
Every goal should link to Canvas assumptions (`10.assumptions.md`):
| `brand` | Followers, reach, authority, audience | "Build LinkedIn presence" |
For `business` type goals, read mode from `strategy/canvas/00.mode.md`:
| `auto` | Low-risk, well-understood domain | AI creates threads and executes without asking |
| `ask` | High-risk, novel, or user preference | AI recommends, waits for approval |
| `hybrid` | Default | Auto for impact <0.5, ask for impact ≥0.5 |
- Set autonomy to `auto` for high-impact goals without asking
- Existing goals (`strategy/goals/active/*`) - avoid conflicts, find linkages
Autonomy default: hybrid (speed matters, but stakes high)

content.value_statement: Unclear objectives make execution harder and hide success criteria. This skill turns intent into measurable goals, milestones, and workspace-ready plans.
actual_capabilities: Extracts objective, motivation, deadline, constraints, and desired outcomes from user input.
Classifies goals as business, brand, product, learning, or custom.
Defines measurable success criteria and milestone checkpoints.
Breaks large objectives into subgoals, dependencies, and thread types.
Uses LeanOS canvas sections to align goals with assumptions and metrics.
Drafts a goal file structure for active LeanOS goals.
limitations: Requires LeanOS canvas and goal paths to provide full context.
Asks for missing deadlines or unclear success criteria before finalizing a goal.
Does not execute the threads created from subgoals.
High-impact goals still require user confirmation before autonomous execution.

use_cases.title: Create a Revenue Goal
use_cases.description: Turn a revenue target into success criteria, milestones, subgoals, and canvas assumption links.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Convert a launch objective into deliverables, dependencies, checkpoints, and measurable release criteria.

use_cases.title: Structure a Learning Plan
use_cases.description: Break a skill objective into clear outcomes, practice milestones, and progress measures.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Goal
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner goal setup from one sentence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this objective into a structured goal: [objective]. Ask me for any missing deadline or success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Business Goal
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a business goal for [target] by [deadline]. Use my LeanOS canvas to align metrics, constraints, and assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Link Goal to Canvas
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform [objective] into a goal and identify which canvas assumptions it validates or updates.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Active Goals
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across existing goal files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my active goals against this new objective: [objective]. Suggest whether to create, merge, replace, or keep goals separate.

output_examples.input: I want to reach $50K monthly recurring revenue by the end of Q2.
output_examples.output: A business goal with revenue, customer, profit, milestone, subgoal, dependency, and canvas assumption sections.

output_examples.input: Build my LinkedIn presence for thought leadership.
output_examples.output: A brand goal with audience metrics, content cadence milestones, engagement subgoals, and inbound lead criteria.

output_examples.input: Ship the mobile app this quarter.
output_examples.output: A product goal with release criteria, beta milestones, app store dependencies, and risk checkpoints.

best_practices: Provide a deadline, baseline metrics, and target outcomes before creating the goal.
Keep each success criterion measurable and independently verifiable.
Review canvas links so the goal supports current strategy and assumptions.
anti_patterns: Do not create goals from vague intent without measurable outcomes.
Do not set high-impact goals to automatic execution without approval.
Do not create duplicate goals when an active goal can be merged or refined.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates structured goal plans with objectives, criteria, subgoals, milestones, state tracking, and canvas links.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require a LeanOS workspace?
faq.answer: It is designed for LeanOS paths, especially strategy canvas files and active goal files.

faq.question: What happens if my objective is vague?
faq.answer: It asks for missing success criteria, deadlines, resources, or constraints before finalizing the goal.

faq.question: Can it execute the plan automatically?
faq.answer: It defines autonomy levels, but high-impact work should wait for user confirmation.

faq.question: Does it run shell commands?
faq.answer: No. The scanned skill file contains Markdown instructions and examples, not executable shell commands.
